observations.Goal: Same long criterion is visible in baseline and A0. A0 wide uses the request/criterion preview; narrow list stacks preview below the list. Detail preserves Korean/English authored criterion and separate absent proof/measurement/review observations.
observations.Task: Both selected baseline/A0 detail panels identify task-surface-active and the same repeated original request. Baseline leads with ID/Goal/time metadata; A0 leads with request/status/owner. List selections and row order differ across fixtures. Task history shows actual HTTP 503 task_history_unavailable in wide detail, preserved independently of the readable request.
observations.Board: A0 retained closed-post panels show original body before closure summary/successor; selected EN wide open-post frame also contains the actual comment. The fixture has no hearth census; that observation remains visible.
observations.Memory: Selected source-bound fact content and file SHA are visible in list/detail; native health reports two ordinary + one source fact for sourcereader, zero ordinary + one source fact for quietreader. Snapshot save time, fact age, source counts and actual pass-stopped/Addon-unattached warnings are distinct. A0 health labels say failed while pass detail says stopped; final source corrects that label but is not natively recaptured.
observations.Locale: Separate A0 KO/EN sessions follow their configured UI language while bilingual authored titles, requests, post bodies, comments and memory content remain unchanged. IDs/proper names and raw server reasons are preserved.
